description: This file declares the AddressTrackerLinux class, which manages network interface addresses and online links on Linux systems using rtnetlink. It provides mechanisms for tracking network changes, callbacks, and interface information, primarily used by network change notification components.

classes.name: AddressTrackerLinux
classes.description: Manages network interface addresses and online links on Linux, providing tracking, callbacks, and interface info for network change notifications.

methods.name: AddressTrackerLinux
methods.description: Default constructor for non-tracking mode, takes a snapshot of current system configuration.

methods.name: AddressTrackerLinux
methods.description: Constructor for tracking mode, sets callbacks for address, link, and tunnel changes, ignored interfaces, and optional blocking thread runner.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Starts watching system configuration for changes in tracking mode.

methods.name: InitWithFdForTesting
methods.description: Initializes with a provided file descriptor for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetAddressMap
methods.description: Returns current address map; callable on any thread.

methods.name: GetOnlineLinks
methods.description: Returns set of online interface indices; callable on any thread.

methods.name: GetInitialDataAndStartRecordingDiffs
methods.description: Returns current address map and online links, and starts diff recording; callable on any thread.

methods.name: SetDiffCallback
methods.description: Sets callback for detecting diffs in address map and online links; only in tracking mode.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionType
methods.description: Returns current network connection type; blocks until Init completes.

methods.name: GetInterfaceName
methods.description: Returns interface name given index, similar to if_indextoname.

methods.name: IsTunnelInterfaceName
methods.description: Checks if interface name refers to a tunnel.
